content: Injectable therapies, such as GLP-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RAs) and dual GIP/GLP-1 receptor agonists, are specifically recommended for individuals diagnosed with type 2 diabetes who aim to manage their weight in addition to achieving optimal glycemic control. These pharmacological agents have demonstrated significant efficacy in facilitating weight reduction, improving glycosylated hemoglobin (A1C) levels, and mitigating cardiovascular risk factors. This therapeutic approach is particularly advantageous for patients who are managing health complications associated with obesity.
